messages:
Maria V: Heads-up: planning to change who can promote runtime flags from 'dev' to 'prod' in console tomorrow. Need ownership + API shape.
Kevin C: +1 on ownership. Thinking: team-level approvers vs individual. Can we reuse the existing approvals API?
Lia: What telemetry gates should block a promotion? error-rate > 1%? p50 latency spike? sampled regressions?
Samir: Agreed on telemetry blocks. Also need audit trail + TTL for temp overrides. Suggest override_ttl (secs) and 'reason' required.
Maria V: API sketch:
```
POST /api/runtime-configs/:id/promote
Body:
  target: "prod"
  approver: "team:infra"
  dry_run: true
```
Return 202 w/ operation id. If conflict -> 409.
Kevin C: I'd rather see PATCH semantics so we can do partial: `PATCH /api/runtime-configs/:id` { "state": "promote", "target": "prod" }
Lia: For console UX: show live telemetry snapshot and a 'blockers' list before confirm. Also a "dry-run check" button that runs gating rules.
Samir: policy YAML prototype:
```
override_policy:
  max_ttl: 86400
  require_approver: true
  notify_channels: ["#eng-platform", "#oncall"]
gating:
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
  p50_latency_ms_delta: 15
```
ops-bot: @Maria V created runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-promotion
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: canary=5% for 30m, auto-rollforward=on :rocket:
Kevin C: edge-case: concurrent promotes. API should return operation id + precondition e-tag to avoid races.
Maria V: Good call. I'll open a tiny RFC and a PR for the console change. Sync tomorrow 9am. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
